summary: Iteration 48 - Stock Management Upgrade Testing COMPLETE. All 17 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all 11 tabs in Stock panel working correctly. 9 new Apicbase-level features tested: Menu Engineering (Stars/Puzzles/Plowhorses/Dogs), Food Cost % Dashboard, Par Level Auto-Ordering, Allergen & Nutrition Tracking, Supplier Price History, Yield Management, Perishable Forecasting (FIFO), Multi-Outlet Transfers, Inventory Turnover Rate.
critical_code_review_comments: All 9 new Stock Management endpoints working correctly
Menu Engineering classifies recipes as star/puzzle/plowhorse/dog based on margin vs sales averages
Food Cost % Dashboard uses COGS formula with target range 28-35%
Auto-order generates POs for products where current_stock < par_level grouped by supplier
Allergen report aggregates allergens from recipe ingredients
Price history tracks supplier price changes with timestamps
Yield analysis calculates effective cost based on yield percentage
Perishable alerts check expiry_days from last purchase date with FIFO logic
Transfer creates paired transfer_out/transfer_in movements between outlets
Turnover rate = COGS / avg_inventory with target 4-8x monthly
Waste tracking includes reason codes (expired, spoiled, overproduction, etc.)
Stock panel has 11 tabs: Products, Recipes, Movements, Suppliers & POs, Stock Counts, Cost %, Menu Engineering, Theo vs Actual, Turnover, Expiry Alerts, Variances
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created - used existing products from property 'city-gate'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 48 upgraded Stock Management with 9 new Apicbase-level features. Stock panel now has 11 tabs. Use property_id 'city-gate' for testing.
